page_title: VIL 4-2 OSA | Villarreal v Osasuna 03/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

90+6' A lofted pass to the edge of the six-yard box is won in the air by Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna), but his tame header goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
90+6' The ball goes out of play. Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
90+6' Osasuna earn a corner.

90+5' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Osasuna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+5' A lofted cross from Ruben Pena (Osasuna) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
90+4' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
90+4' Referee Alejandro Quintero halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Vicente Moreno, then shows him a yellow.
90+2' Substitution. Kike Barja (Osasuna) on for Jesus Areso.
90+2' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90+1' Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
89' Alex Baena (Villarreal) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
89' What was Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
88' The referee gives a yellow card to Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
87' Denis Suarez (Villarreal) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
84' Osasuna will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
83' Yellow card. Santi Comesana (Villarreal) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
82' Here's the change. Dani Parejo leaves the pitch and Denis Suarez (Villarreal) comes on as a substitute.
81' 4 - 2 Goal! Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Junior Reis.
81' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
81' It’s a PENALTY to Osasuna after the VAR review!
80' Referee Alejandro Quintero makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Osasuna. Let’s see what happens!
79' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

79' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Osasuna have a corner.

77' Great solo effort by Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) as he beats two defenders before unleashing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes a decent save.
76' Substitution. Ruben Garcia will be replaced by Ruben Pena (Osasuna).
76' Here is a change. Ante Budimir is going off and Vicente Moreno gives the last tactical orders to Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Juan Foyth as he is replaced by Willy Kambwala (Villarreal).

75' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
75' Osasuna control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
74' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) tries to find Alex Baena, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
73' 5:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.

71' 4 - 1 Alex Baena sends a superb cross into the box. Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the bottom right corner, leaving Sergio Herrera beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 4:1.
71' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Thierno Barry will be replaced by Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal).
70' A substitution has been made. Pape Gueye goes off and Alex Baena (Villarreal) comes on.
70' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
68' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
68' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
66' 3 - 1 Goal! Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
65' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Pape Gueye (Villarreal) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
64' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for an infringement.
63' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
62' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) commits a foul during an attacking move.
61' Pau Navarro (Villarreal) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
61' Pau Navarro (Villarreal) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Quintero saw the whole situation.
61' A substitution has been made. Unai Garcia is replaced by Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
59' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Junior Reis, who smothers the ball.
58' Corner kicks – 2:4.

56' A rebound falls at the feet of Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
56' Villarreal force a corner. They send men into the box.

55' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Villarreal.

55' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Villarreal, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
53' Alejandro Quintero blows the whistle, Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) is penalised for a foul.
51' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Abel Bretones (Osasuna) offside.
51' Osasuna are seeing far more of the ball now.
49' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul.
49' The attendance is 17147.
48' Flag goes up against Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
46' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
46' Substitution. Moi Gomez makes his way off the pitch and Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) comes on as his replacement.
46' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Pau Navarro (Villarreal) replaces Kiko Femenia.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+3' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45+2' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45+2' Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

45' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) sends an accurate short pass. Ante Budimir controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort. Ante Budimir (Osasuna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
44' The shots on goal statistics – 4:1.

42' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Villarreal will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
39' 3 - 0 Goal! Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
39' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
38' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul.
36' Some neat passing and movement from Osasuna as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
33' 2 - 0 Goal! Thierno Barry (Villarreal) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and fires the ball inside the back of the net.
33' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.
31' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
30' Osasuna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
30' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Osasuna are going to take it.
29' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Pape Gueye (Villarreal) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

28' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Villarreal are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
27' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
25' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle. Unai Garcia (Osasuna) commits a foul after dangerous play.
24' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
23' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
21' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
20' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Sergio Herrera.
18' Osasuna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
18' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
17' Osasuna will take a corner kick.
17' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Osasuna.
16' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) commits a rough foul. Alejandro Quintero stops the game and makes a call.
15' 32:68 – the ratio of ball possession.
14' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) sends a long ball forward to Jesus Areso, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.

13' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
12' Osasuna enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
12' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) with a wonderful solo effort. He blasted from long range, but the shot towards the bottom right corner was thwarted by Junior Reis.

10' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies miles over the crossbar. Very poor shot. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
10' Corner kick. Villarreal will have an opportunity.
10' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Villarreal.
9' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
7' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
6' The ball is cleared after Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
6' Some great controlled play and passing from Villarreal. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

2' 1 - 0 Goal! Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) latches on to a superb pass inside the box, finds himself in a promising position and fires a shot in off the crossbar. The goalkeeper was helpless to keep out his effort.
2' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) was too forceful with his tackle and Alejandro Quintero interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' The first half has started.
Osasuna will kick the game off.
Alejandro Quintero was nominated as the referee for this game.
